verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a design SaaS platform with automation APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence covers programmatic automation (Connect APIs, Autofill, Bulk create, MCP-driven design generation and export), but nothing documents a native scheduler, recurring triggers, or cron-style workflow execution. Any recurrence would have to come from external tooling calling the APIs, which the evidence never describes.
